answer: Each identity must lock value in a vault before it can attest, and that stake is slashed the moment the key vouches for a sybil cluster. Splitting one actor into a thousand puppets means a thousand separate stakes, so the attack becomes a purchase rather than a trick. A reputation vine adds a second gate: influence grows only with time under scrutiny, so clones start at zero and cannot graft onto the trust of the account that spawned them. A public terrace stage exposes one payer funding many mouths, letting the honest majority refuse that cluster.
